push_headlines: Europe rallied on Wednesday: the DAX +1.35% to a one-month high, the FTSE 100 +0.19%.
Asia on Wednesday: the KOSPI +3.30%, the Nikkei 225 +0.85%, the Hang Seng -0.70%.
Brent near $110 as attacks on Gulf shipping and Saudi Arabia keep oil elevated.
on_notice: Oil near $110 Brent, with reported attacks on shipping near the Strait of Hormuz and on Saudi Arabia; watch for any overnight spike.
The ECB meeting next week, with Brent near $110 keeping inflation concern alive.
Reports of a Thursday Asian sell-off tied to Houthi strikes conflict on levels, so check the Asia open before trusting any figure.

asia.headline: Asia mixed on Wednesday: the KOSPI +3.30%, the Nikkei 225 +0.85%.
asia.detail: The KOSPI closed at 5,735.66 with chip and tech stocks leading, and the Nikkei 225 closed at 64,621.24. No verified Thursday close was found, and reports of a Thursday sell-off conflict on levels, so these are Wednesday readings.

sources.name: US News / AP, Asian shares mixed

china.headline: Greater China lower on Wednesday: the Hang Seng -0.70%.
china.detail: The Hang Seng closed at 23,707.11 on Wednesday. No verified Thursday close was found.

sources.name: US News / AP, Asian shares mixed

europe.headline: Europe higher on Wednesday: the DAX +1.35%, the FTSE 100 +0.19%.
europe.detail: The DAX closed at 25,645.04, its highest close in about a month, and the FTSE 100 closed at 10,752.88 after opening lower on UK inflation of 3.5%. No Thursday close was found.

sources.name: BBN Times, European stock markets today

latam.headline: No usable same-day Latin America report found tonight.
latam.detail: Searches returned only undated or older sessions, so no index levels are quoted here.

mideast.headline: Brent near $110 as the Iran war keeps oil elevated.
mideast.detail: Brent was near $110 ahead of next week's European Central Bank meeting, with reported attacks on shipping near the Strait of Hormuz and on Saudi Arabia keeping supply concerns in focus.
